decisions.reason: Because it is close to the firm's established hearing-business offer in a growing industry and has only been on the market since 2023, management is likely to continue it despite any early uncertainty, though the lighter website commitment makes withdrawal somewhat easier than for the others.

As a close-to-core product with its own page and recent launch, it reflects visible commitment and sunk development effort, so management would be inclined to keep backing it rather than reverse course quickly.

This unit fits the firm's strategic push toward efficient, integrated production systems and was publicly presented on its own page, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit both favor keeping it on the market.
